purpose: Heavy Rebuild clean-master architectural program for a ruined municipal police station with coherent public, administrative, evidence, secure-processing, and service zones.
architectural_rules: Public circulation must stop at controlled reception/interview functions and must not freely penetrate secure operations.
The sally-port route must connect exterior secure vehicle access to processing and holding without crossing the public lobby.
Evidence intake and storage must form a controlled chain separated from unrestricted public circulation.
Operations, records, communications, and staff support must remain mutually accessible through a coherent staff circulation network.
Secure doors, barriers, and corridors must express zoning without making the structure globally impassable for exploration.

damage_doctrine.intent: Civic-security building abandoned under disaster conditions while preserving readable controlled-zone relationships.
